Existing injection names say uncertain IOException, but old means no write, new means fully completed ordinary write then IOException, third means fully completed other image then IOException. Those cases carry no actual common nonCommitted journal/CSP and should retain exact readback policy; do not replace them with fake CSP or treat as actual Unknown qualification.
